exit_rule: entry_lb//4 or entry_lb//2, minimum 3; opposite completed-close then next-open fill
same_bar_policy: stop or adverse gap stop is executable before a later completed-channel exit; payoff follow-up resolves stop before target
development_gate: 24bp positive, at least 100 trades, positive top-10%-winner-removed return, both half-years positive; after-loser must improve matched all at 12/18/24bp
later_period_open_rule: 2024 only after development gate; 2025 conditional; 2026 sealed
